title: Alkanes Asian Market Drove 61% of Bitcoin Transactions for 90 Days, SUBFROST Data Shows
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Alkanes Asian Market Drove 61% of Bitcoin Transactions for 90 Days, SUBFROST Data Shows SUBFROST said Alkanes made up 61.1% of all Bitcoin transactions from June 23 to Sept. 20 — about 59.9 million txs across blocks 954,917–967,918. This post Alkanes Asian Market Drove 61% of Bitcoin Transactions for 90 Days, SUBFROST Data Shows first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Juan Galt .
